name: Cua Huynh De
summary: Cua Huỳnh Đế is a deep-water crab with a thick red-pink shell, firm white meat, and rich roe, found off Sa Huỳnh and Lý Sơn. The meat is deeply sweet and fragrant, steamed, grilled with salt and chili, or cooked into porridge or hotpot.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the meat white, firm, deeply sweet, and mildly fragrant, and the roe very rich. ZaloPay calls the meat firm, fragrant, and richly sweet.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: steam, grill with salt and chili, or cook as porridge.
ZaloPay: steam, porridge, or hotpot. It places the crab in clean water at Sa Huỳnh and Lý Sơn.
where: Deep sea, in Vietnam Airlines. Sa Huỳnh and Lý Sơn, in ZaloPay.
priceBand: 900,000–1,800,000 VND a kilogram, by type and size (Vietnam Airlines).
seoDescription: Cua Huỳnh Đế, the deep-water crab of Sa Huỳnh and Lý Sơn, sweet white meat and rich roe. 900,000–1,800,000 VND a kilogram.
